Sources and licenses

Every dataset and outlet NK15068 draws on, with licenses and the dates the research was compiled.

Map data and licenses

  • Overture Maps Foundation — places, buildings, transportation, addresses, divisions, base · CDLA-Permissive-2.0 / ODbL (OpenStreetMap-derived layers) · release 2026-08-19.0
  • OpenStreetMap contributors · ODbL
  • US Census TIGER/Line ZCTA5 (ZIP 15068 boundary) · Public domain
  • Terrain Tiles on AWS (Mapzen terrarium; USGS 3DEP / SRTM) · Public domain / attribution

The map data was built Sept. 23, 2026: 1,256 places, 790 named streets, 19,242 buildings and 16,051 address points. Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors, Overture Maps Foundation.

Research

  • News briefs, city offices, parks and places to eat: compiled Sept. 23, 2026. 20 news briefs, 21 public offices, 10 parks and 32 places to eat and drink.
  • History: compiled Sept. 23, 2026. 61 dated events, 9 neighborhoods, 18 landmarks, 8 yearly events and 21 notable people.
  • Lost and found pet contacts and tips: checked Sept. 23, 2026. 18 contacts and 6 tips.

Each entry links to where it was published. Where sources disagree, the entry says so.

Crime, crash and police data

  • FBI Uniform Crime Reporting figures, 2000–2024, for each department, as compiled by Jacob Kaplan (crimedatatool_helper): offenses, clearances, arrests and staffing.
  • PennDOT crash records, 2005–2024: crashes that killed or seriously injured someone, 150 in the three cities.
  • The Washington Post’s database of fatal police shootings: 2 in the three cities.
  • The police blotter: 43 incidents from 8 local news outlets, each placed on its block and linked to the report.
